package relay

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/xallor-ai/xallor-remote/internal/protocol"
)

// The overlay cancels only after the real identity gate was acquired. The real
// handler must release it and leave the same device available for a new caller.
func TestHandoffGateOverlay_shouldRelease_whenCancelledAfterAcquisition(t *testing.T) {
	h, device, _, _ := routingFixture(t)
	client := &contextSender{ctx: context.Background()}
	if code := h.RegisterClient("device", "grant", "", client); code != "" {
		t.Fatal("fixture registration failed", code)
	}
	injected := false
	client.ctx = context.WithValue(context.Background(), "xr-test-handoff-after-acquire", func(cancel context.CancelFunc) {
		injected = true
		cancel()
	})
	before := len(device.got)
	h.Handle(client, protocol.RoleClient, "device", protocol.Message{Type: protocol.TypeInvoke, ExecID: "cancelled-handoff", Op: protocol.OpHandoffSubmit})
	if !injected {
		t.Fatal("post-acquisition cancellation was not injected")
	}
	if reply := client.last(); reply.Code != protocol.RelayError || reply.ExecID != "cancelled-handoff" {
		t.Fatal("cancelled handoff did not return correlated refusal", reply)
	}
	if len(device.got) != before || len(h.inflight) != 0 || len(h.requests) != 0 {
		t.Error("cancelled handoff was dispatched or retained a route")
	}
	h.identities.mu.Lock()
	remaining := len(h.identities.entries)
	h.identities.mu.Unlock()
	if remaining != 0 {
		t.Error("cancelled handoff retained the acquired identity gate")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if code := h.RegisterClient("device", "grant", "", &contextSender{ctx: ctx}); code != "" {
		t.Fatal("subsequent same-device client could not register", code)
	}
}
